scope: development-only protected DOFA-v2 fusion selection on MARS physical-site folds 3 and 4
hypothesis: The replicated DOFA-v2 representation improves plume-scene ranking but perturbs two decisions near the pooled no-plume operating point. Restricting fusion to a disjoint high-confidence region can retain complementary AP gains while mathematically preserving the current decision region.
fusion: For current scores below gate, output current exactly. Above gate, rescale current to [0,1], blend its logit with the fixed DOFA probability, then map the result back to [gate,1].
selection_rule: Rank candidates by all-gates pass, point-gate stability, paired-site AP lower bound, minimum fold AP delta, minimum sensor AP delta, pooled AP delta, then prefer the smaller gate and weight.
interpretation: Passing authorizes only one-shot fold-2 DOFA feature extraction and frozen confirmation. Failure rejects the protected fusion branch without accessing fold 2.
